topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I was just getting settled in for the day, coffee on the desk, lesson plans open, when a small package was placed on my chair. It was wrapped in simple brown paper, the kind you keep around for spur-of-the-moment gifts. The handwriting on the tag was unmistakable—Lucy’s. She graduated three years ago, and I hadn’t heard from her since her email farewell. Inside was a book, one I’d mentioned in passing during a discussion about classic literature. A note read, “For sparking more than just curiosity. Thanks for the inspiration.” It’s moments like these that make the quiet joys of teaching truly resonate.
